_comment: T1988 engine/input and ai/pathfinding trace regions (<=16). Addresses are the global constants the c2r translations of the selected roots read or write (crates/tsfp-ports/src/c2r/engine_input.rs, ai_pathfinding.rs), see docs/t-tier2-input.md. input_ring = the button-sequence ring 0x75AEC8 (ten halfword pairs) plus its head index 0x75AEF0 pushed by 0x1CCE70 and scanned by 0x1CCF80 (the 'pad ring head' capture of docs/t1974-hud-tier2.md). pad_table = the per-player pad entries 0x6B93C0..0x6B94D0 written by 0x438B0 and read by 0x42B60/0x42970. pad_poll_state = the 0x18FF70 device state block 0x74CF70..0x74D104. pad_flags = 0x47DF00..0x47DF48. nav_occupancy = 0x715F2C used by 0x2A5C30.
